checklist.name: Rooftop PV on a factory hall (Client A)
checklist.summary:
- All 412 panels installed on the roof.
- Total capacity: 224.5 kWp.
- Both inverters mounted.
- Cabling approximately 80% complete.
- Awaiting new circuit breaker delivery.

issues.text: Awaiting delivery of new circuit breaker from supplier.

checklist.name: Battery storage for an existing PV plant (Client B)
checklist.summary:
- Battery container installed on the slab.
- Wiring of the new low-voltage switchboard ongoing.
- Existing transformer remains in place.
- Commissioning planned in 14 days.

checklist.name: PV on a family house with battery and EV charger (Family C)
checklist.summary:
- Conducted site survey.
- Confirmed roof suitability for 22 panels (9.9 kWp).
- Installation planned for early December.
- Awaiting contract signature.

issues.text: Waiting for the client to sign the contract.

checklist.name: Rooftop PV on the parking house – OC Futurum, Brno
checklist.summary:
- Completed installation of all 1,816 solar panels.
- Achieved total power output of 998.8 kWp.
- Connected all 908 optimizers.
- Finished cable route to the main switchboard.

checklist.name: Rooftop PV + battery on three municipal buildings – Bělotín
checklist.summary:
- Solar panels installed on building one.
- Battery storage cabinet placed in building one.
- Wiring in progress.
- New roof covering completed on building two.
- Rails installation scheduled for next week.
- Roof replacement for building three starts Wednesday.

checklist.name: Rooftop PV + battery with blackout backup – Pekárna Javor
checklist.summary:

- Battery system in place, 233 kWh.
- Backup circuit for oven conveyor wired.
- Blackout test planned for next Thursday.

site.title: Rooftop PV + battery with blackout backup – Pekárna Javor
site.entry:
- All solar panels installed, 86.42 kWp.
- Battery system in place, 233 kWh.
- Backup circuit for oven conveyor wired.
- Blackout test planned for next Thursday.
next: Conduct blackout test with the owner next Thursday.
site.photo_note: Photos: published reference photos of the project.
site.transcript:
[00:00] Week 47, Pekárna Javor.
[00:06] New this week: all panels are installed, 86.42 kWp.
[00:15] The battery is in place – 233 kWh, here are the cabinets in the technical room.
[00:28] Backup circuit for the oven conveyor is wired: if the grid fails, the conveyor keeps running so the bread doesn't burn.
[00:45] Blackout test planned with the owner next Thursday after the morning shift.

site.transcript:
[00:00] Week 47, factory hall, Client A.
[00:06] New this week: all 412 panels are on the roof, that's 224.5 kWp. This is the view from the north edge.
[00:22] Now I'm in the switchboard room – both inverters are mounted, cabling is about 80 percent done.
[00:40] The client was at the inspection meeting on Tuesday and was satisfied.
[00:48] Still missing: the new circuit breaker from the supplier, delivery on Monday.
[00:55] Electrical inspection is planned for the 28th.
